description: This file defines a Smarty plugin - specifically, a modifier called 'escape' used for escaping strings according to various specified types (e.g., HTML, URL, JavaScript). It contains a single function, smarty_modifier_escape, which implements the escaping logic based on the provided escapement type.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_escape
methods.description: Escapes a string according to the specified escapement type (e.g., HTML, URL, JavaScript, etc.). It supports multiple escape modes and uses global configuration for character set if not provided.
